summary: Typing a number over a selected range of editable Dataset cells now fills the whole range.
details: Select any range in the Data tab of an editable dataset and start typing: every editable cell in the selection takes the number as you type it, matching how the Result Selection Method grid fills highlighted weights.
Successive keystrokes build one number, a decimal point and a leading minus sign are accepted, and noneditable cells such as masked triangle cells and Total are skipped.
Selecting a single cell still opens the inline editor as before.
